title: Genesis 3:8-9 — Adam and Eve hide; the LORD God calls “Where are you?”
summary: Genesis 3:8-9 in English: Adam and Eve hear the LORD God walking in the garden and hide among the trees, and the LORD God calls to the man, “Where are you?” The words LORD God and the word “trees” are highlighted in colour.

text.text: 8 They heard the sound of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
9 Then the LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

keywords: voice of the LORD God walking in the garden
